0xf09a4016.notice: Runs the ENS reverse-claimer + access-control module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.registrar: The external ENS reverse registrar the facet forwards `setName` to.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for an ENS reverse-claim diamond — seeds AccessControl (so the registrar setter and `setEnsName` are `ENS_MANAGER_ROLE`-gated), registers the IENSReverseClaimer interface (ERC-165), and wires the external ENS reverse registrar the facet forwards `setName` to. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Reverts {ENSReverseClaimerZeroRegistrar} for a zero registrar.
